project.name: clide
project.description:
Ant stub Build File
Produces a jar of empty stand-ins for the org.apache.tools.ant.* types that PlantUML's Ant tasks (CheckZipTask, PlantUmlTask) reference, just enough for clide/jdtls to compile those files without the full (fairly large) real ant.jar. See README.md in this folder for the full rationale.
IMPORTANT: includeantruntime="false" below is what keeps this from being circular. Without it, the javac task would add Ant's own runtime jars (the REAL org.apache.tools.ant.* classes the `ant` command itself is running with) to the compile classpath, which would collide with the stub classes we are defining right here with the same names. With it false, javac only sees the JDK plus whatever we put in classes.dir - a clean, isolated compile.
